text:
violet (product): quick sync  sales flagged three tricky customer asks: cross-region legal-hold (data in EU + US), partial-BYOK where only embeddings are customer-keyed, and a request for export resumability. want a tight spec we can hand to eng+security.

ash (eng): noted. plan: export manifest must include per-object `region` and `encryption_scope` (values: platform, customer-embeddings, customer-all). resumable exports: each shard gets `export_cursor` so we can resume failed shards. small sketch: `export_manifest.objects[] = {path, sha256, size, region, encryption_scope, export_cursor}`.

samir (security): security constraints: signed manifest + per-shard signature. For partial-BYOK we need to indicate which objects are encrypted under customer keys and include `kms_key_id` + `kms_key_policy_snapshot`. Also require proof-of-immutability for cross-region (signed manifest + storage-checksum + region-timestamp). acceptance: during canary security will validate resume semantics (simulate interrupted export and resume) and validate BYOK object signatures.

zoe (legal): legal requirements: cross-region holds must surface `jurisdiction` and `custody_ticket`. need API to pin only a subset (e.g., embeddings) without pinning whole tenant. also require evidence bundle to include a human-readable index and `legal_hold.ordering` (case docket id). SLA expectations: preview 48h, resumable export completion 10d for large ranges.

rachel (ops): ops caveats: resumable exports complicate idempotency and storage—we need a TTL for cursors and a background compactor to remove orphaned partial shards. propose `export_cursor_ttl=30d` default. rate-limit resumptions per-tenant to avoid thundering herd. storage impact estimate +6%. will add dashboard for "stalled-resumable-exports".

avh (product): (typo fixed) violet (product): decisions by Mon: (1) manifest fields for region/enc scope/export_cursor/jurisdiction, (2) cursor TTL and resumability rules, (3) acceptance tests (resume + BYOK partial validation + cross-region sample), (4) canary cadence.

ash (eng): canary suggestion: 6 tenants: 2 cross-region, 2 partial-BYOK, 2 standard. run for 72h with forced resume test. feature flag `exports.resumable_v1`.

samir (security): thumbs up. security will run simulated key-rotation mid-export to ensure we record `kms_key_version` per object and that verification still works.

zoe (legal): legal ok with resumability as long as index + custody_ticket are in manifest and we keep `requester_email` audit trail.

rachel (ops): will prepare runbook for compaction and stuck-cursor remediation. will also add cost telemetry to canary dashboards.

deploy-bot: created INF-6017, scheduled canary window.

violet (product): thanks all  i'll draft an RFC with minimal schema and acceptance checklist. will ping when ready for review.
